name: Planner-only backlog consolidation
description:
Consolidate all genuinely-open work that still lives outside the planner into structured planner entities, then remove the legacy repository-level backlog files. Evidence gathered from the current repo state:
- `AGENTS.md:1-120+`, `PROJECT.md:1-80`, and `ROADMAP.md:1-40` still mandate `CHECKLIST.md` as an operational source of truth.
- `CHECKLIST.md` still contains open items that are not modeled in the planner, while `BACKLOG.md` is also being used as a durable backlog.
- Open code-backed gaps confirmed during read-only audit:
  - no `planner-feature-discuss` flow exists; only phase/task discuss tools are present in `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:586-726` and Pi command routing in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:1686-1903`.
  - `/handoff` UI has no delete action in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/handoff.route.tsx:1-103`, even though delete API support exists in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/api.ts:206-219`.
  - no orphan cleanup command is implemented (`cleanup-orphans` / `orphan` search across `packages/` returned no hits).
  - requirements CRUD exists server-side in `packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts:221-245`, but there is no requirements route in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/`.
  - `PlanStoreError` still wraps `readJson` failures as `read failed: <path>` in `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:334` without surfacing useful schema diagnostics.
  - project edit UI only exposes `goal` in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/project-edit.route.tsx` and `project-edit.action.ts`.
  - multi-harness docs/schema and Zed integration remain absent from the repo (`docs/setup-claude-code.md` exists, but no Codex/Zed/public schema deliverable was found).
Goal: make the planner the sole structured backlog for this project, preserve the already-planned recap tasks in P034 (`T136`, `T137`) without duplication, and capture the residual work as explicit tasks under one new feature before deleting `CHECKLIST.md` and `BACKLOG.md`.

acceptedDecisions.title: Planner is the only backlog source of truth
acceptedDecisions.decision: Migrate genuinely-open items from CHECKLIST.md and BACKLOG.md into planner entities, then delete both legacy files and remove their governance references from project docs.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: The repository currently splits operational truth between planner data and two markdown backlogs, which creates drift. The read-only audit confirmed that some items are real gaps and others are stale historical notes; planner capture plus file removal eliminates ambiguity.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Keep existing open planner work in P034 (T136/T137) where it already belongs. Only migrate items that are still real after code inspection. Update AGENTS.md, PROJECT.md, and ROADMAP.md so they no longer require CHECKLIST.md.
